scope: Five proven unused direct roots; this is not a grep-based automatic deletion catalog.

retiredRoots.name: @ast-grep/napi
retiredRoots.reason: No NAPI consumer or executable export; structural search selects the separately verified native CLI.

retiredRoots.name: @swc/core
retiredRoots.reason: No selected SWC parser/module consumer; production parser identity selects Babel, Acorn and Esprima.

retiredRoots.name: @mdx-js/mdx
retiredRoots.reason: No MDX compiler/build consumer; the .mdx route uses the Markdown chunker.

retiredRoots.name: @vscode/ripgrep
retiredRoots.reason: No rgPath consumer or bin export; dictionary generation selects PATH rg or its filesystem walk.

retiredRoots.name: tree-sitter-lua
retiredRoots.reason: Native registry and its derived bootstrap inventory select only the scoped grammar; logical route/caps labels are not package imports.

retainedExceptions.name: @tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-lua
retainedExceptions.role: selected native grammar and bootstrap activation

retainedExceptions.name: apache-arrow
retainedExceptions.role: explicit @lancedb/lancedb peer provision; legacy peer resolution does not supply it implicitly

retainedExceptions.name: esquery
retainedExceptions.role: real @es-joy/jsdoccomment and ESLint transitive consumers remain

retainedExceptions.name: nan
retainedExceptions.role: retained while the optional re2 dependency still requires it

executionExceptions.name: ast-grep
executionExceptions.role: separate canonical managed/external CLI; no use of the retired NAPI root

executionExceptions.name: rg
executionExceptions.role: explicit PATH command in dictionary discovery with filesystem fallback; no bundled ripgrep claim
